label: Boltz-2's affinity module
context: Show a protein (curved chain of 30 grey beads) with a ligand (6 warm atoms) in a pocket. Phase 1: the predicted complex structure from the denoiser appears. Phase 2 'crop the pocket': a circle selects ligand + nearby protein tokens (highlight about 10 tokens); the corresponding sub-block of the pair matrix z (draw a 12×12 matrix and highlight the pocket rows/cols plus ligand) is extracted along with pairwise distances of the predicted pose. Phase 3: a box 'affinity Pairformer' processes it, then two heads output 'binder probability: 0.93' (as a gauge) and 'affinity: log10 IC50 = −6.8' (as a number on a scale). Caption: 'affinity is predicted from the trunk's pair features restricted to the pocket and the predicted pose'. Canvas is responsive: width anywhere from 340 to 900 px, height 400 px; derive every size and position from width and height, keep all text at least 11 px and fully inside the canvas, and on narrow widths stack or shrink rather than overlap. Loop forever on a cycle of 10 to 16 s with smooth easing between phases. White background. Put a one-line phase caption at the top centre that changes with the phase. No title inside the canvas (the card has one). Use plain sans-serif labels.

spec.title: Boltz-2 affinity module: pocket crop of z and pose distances
spec.caption: Affinity is predicted from the trunk's pair features restricted to the pocket and the predicted pose.
